name: io.github.topdawgyq/oyapicks-mcp
title: OyaPicks
description: Prediction-market data as MCP tools, paid per call in USDC on Algorand or Base via x402.

environmentVariables.name: OYAPICKS_ALGO_MNEMONIC
environmentVariables.description: 25-word Algorand mnemonic of a wallet holding USDC (ASA 31566704). Set this OR the Base key.

environmentVariables.name: OYAPICKS_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 0x-prefixed Base private key of a wallet holding USDC on Base. Set this OR the Algorand mnemonic.

environmentVariables.name: OYAPICKS_RAIL
environmentVariables.description: Only needed when both wallets are set: algorand or base.
